info.name: My Groups
info.summary: Let users join groups on request, and let group admins manage their members
info.description:
**My Groups** gives every user a page listing the groups they belong to.
- Users can ask to join the groups that platform admins opened to requests. - Group admins receive an email and a notification for each request, and can accept or refuse it. - Group admins see the full member list of their groups, and can add any Nextcloud account or remove members.
Group admins are designated by platform admins in the app settings. They are not the Nextcloud group admins (subadmins): they only manage the membership of their groups, and get no right on the accounts themselves.
info.author: Sébastien Marinier
